correctness.rationale: A weighted block-expansion LCS identity follows by bipartite matching polytope integrality. Weak descents in opposed permutation orders bound the skeleton length by 2k-1 and the maximum-symbol count by k; two heaviest alternating blocks attain kA+(k-1)B. Equality and gap-order reversal force the unique-top optimizer census t^floor(k/2). Explicit finite DP and brute optimal-string checks support, without replacing, the infinite proof.

value.rationale: An all-parameter exact invariant of an unbounded periodic string family collapses to its two largest run lengths, rather than needing quadratic dynamic programming. It yields exact deletion distance to palindromicity and complete count and structure of optimal words with unique top length. This structural stability and optimizer rigidity is a natural, nontrivial characterization, not just a renamed known unit-run case.
